summary.signal: Engineering AI is moving from advisory interfaces into executable engineering loops: generative/inverse blade design, simulation MCP access, and drawing-to-robot welding.
Scientific AI is becoming more reproducible and action-oriented through validated paper tools, automated synthesis, and experiment-backed materials models.
Digital engineering value is increasingly tied to controlled lifecycle execution: secure MBSE, interoperable digital-twin testbeds, and AI-assisted metrology rather than standalone model demos.
Enterprise adoption is outpacing formal control boundaries, while domain-specialized models and agent-security incidents raise the importance of trust boundaries, auditability and egress controls.

central_signals: Engineering-agent value is shifting toward execution against established simulation, design and manufacturing systems rather than text-only assistance.
Scientific-AI credibility improves when generated decisions are checked against reference outputs, physical experiments or repeatable automated protocols.
Industrial deployment increasingly depends on lifecycle traceability, secure data boundaries and explicit validation gates.
Enterprise AI adoption and agent autonomy are creating governance work at the same time that domain-specific models make controlled deployment more practical.
tensions_or_caveats: Several product and performance statements are vendor-reported; self-reported benchmarks are explicitly labeled and are not treated as independent validation.

The Japanese automated-synthesis and Atria Dawn candidates are preprints; only the former is selected because its open hardware/code and physical synthesis demonstration create a stronger inspectable engineering loop.
Deloitte workforce metrics are self-reported survey results; the £958 million spend estimate and time-saving metric are estimates rather than directly observed productivity.
The Reuters Hugging Face follow-up is a material delta to the previously published RubyGems incident, but it does not establish that the May probing caused the later July breach.
COMSOL 2027 is allowed despite prior COMSOL agentic coverage because the named MCP Server/API and COMSOL Systems capabilities are a concrete product delta.

known_gaps: Company Scout coverage is intentionally CAD/CAE-heavy today because of the watchlist rotation; there are few fresh aircraft-engine OEM product announcements.
Some industrial-AI reports expose headline metrics but insufficient methodology in the Scout artifact, so they remain backlog rather than report-tier selected.
The SimSolid 2026 electromagnetic item is secondary reporting; a first-party primary source was not established during bounded verification.
No cross-scout semantic duplicate remained after integration; Research Scout had already suppressed obvious same-day overlap.

selected.practical_implication: Scientific organizations can package trusted internal methods as agent-callable tools, but should preserve the same validation pattern: reference cases, automated regression tests, failure exclusion and provenance for every callable method.
